Stigmergy's cut with three codings: the rule, written before the field analyst's codes are tallied. (1) Each of the 72 records takes the code at least two of its three coders gave: mine (C5a-01), the fleet reader who coded its member theme (C5c-01), and the field analyst. MP counts as M, as the rule of the read counts it, so codes reduce to M, P and O. (2) Where the three give M, P and O once each, the record is doubtful; I compute the member's verdict with it as M, as P and as O, and where the verdict changes, I read the doubtful records whole and decide, saying why. (3) A member joins what the sources keep apart if P is at least half of its records that are not O (the rule of the read, unchanged). (4) What follows, as written before the read: if T3-041 meets the rule, it moves to Collective representation (T4-006), where proposals of what the mark shows already sit; if T3-038 meets it, I report it, since a split of a third-order theme reassigns second-order themes. T3-060 had no destination written. I write it now, before the tally: if T3-060 meets the rule, it moves to Collective representation too, for the same reason as T3-041 (its proposals are proposals of what the shared mark shows). (5) If no member meets the rule, Stigmergy keeps its cut, and the account reports the three codings.

Working hypothesis: by the three-coder rule logged before the tally (c5c2_stigmergy_three.py), T3-041 (P in 8 to 10 of 15 not O, whichever way its two three-way splits fall) and T3-060 (P in 10 of 20, exactly half) meet the rule and move from Stigmergy (T4-007) to Collective representation (T4-006); T3-038 does not (4 of 14). Pairwise agreement: mine-fleet 57 of 72 (kappa 0.69), mine-field 47 (0.47), fleet-field 48 (0.50). That leaves Stigmergy one member, a rename under C2's criterion for a fourth-order theme; my leaning is to withdraw T4-007 and rest P03 on T3-038 with dimension D02, as R01 rests on third-order themes, keeping the name as a gloss of what T3-038's records show.
